verdict.rationale: The only mobile evidence is that Reflect has an iOS app with a lock-screen widget for one-tap audio memo capture, transcribed by Whisper into the daily note. Search and linking are documented, but nothing shows they work on mobile. Missing for 10: any evidence of an Android app, documentation that search and backlinks/[[linking]] work on mobile, evidence that the mobile apps are full-featured rather than companion apps, and independent hands-on corroboration of the mobile experience.
